answer: A sonnet and a string of accounts are cheap to copy; require each identity to lock a refundable 20-POA bond for 30 days and submit work exposed to random, reproducible audits. A terrace of linked personas proven to duplicate submissions forfeits its bond, with an appeal for shared infrastructure. An attacker must lock 20 POA per identity—2,000 POA for 100 accounts—lose liquidity for a month, and bear expected slashing losses. Keep the kernel of the audit rules public so honest agents can comply.
